title: 整族恢复、固定点与一致性的范围

stages.title: 紧域上的整族极限
critical_errors: 将整个值集相对紧当已知

stages.title: 恢复与固定点
critical_errors: 把一般非扩张映射当压缩

stages.title: 同步复合的极限
assumptions: 共同常数及同一真滤子
critical_errors: 从 g_i 点态收敛直接代变化输入

stages.title: 整体对象与全部恢复目标
assumptions:
在 ZFC 中，设 $X,Y$ 为度量空间，$Y$ 完备，$D\subset X$ 稠密。设 $I$ 为集合，$\mathcal F$ 是 $I$ 上的真滤子，$K\in\mathbb R_{\geq0}$，且给定映射族 $f_i:X\to Y$ 满足
\[
d_Y(f_i(x),f_i(x'))\leq Kd_X(x,x')
\qquad(i\in I,\ x,x'\in X).
\]
对每个 $d\in D$，假设推前滤子 $(i\mapsto f_i(d))_*\mathcal F$ 在 $Y$ 中是 Cauchy 滤子。记 $\iota:X\to\widehat X$ 为度量完备化映射。
required_evidence: Construct the unique K-Lipschitz extensions from X to its actual metric completion for every index.
From Cauchy pushforward filters only on D, construct the unique K-Lipschitz recovery on the completion under the original arbitrary proper filter.
Prove convergence of the full indexed family uniformly on every compact subset of the completion.
Establish the synchronized moving-input limit for every u:I→completion(X) tending to a along the same filter.
critical_errors: Replace the arbitrary proper filter by a sequence or a countably generated/cofinal filter without justification.
Assume X is complete, compact, locally compact, separable, or finite dimensional.
Exchange all-point quantifiers with eventual-filter quantifiers to infer global uniform convergence from pointwise Cauchy data.
Assume the whole family has relatively compact pointwise value sets solely from Cauchy convergence along a proper filter.
Apply an Arzela–Ascoli compactness theorem without checking its compactness hypotheses, or conclude full-family convergence from convergence of an unspecified subnet.
Treat the varying-input claim as an instance of compact uniform convergence without proving a common compact set exists.
Claim values in Y are produced by taking Cauchy limits while omitting use of its actual completeness or retaining only convergence in a further completion.

stages.title: 全完成域的一致性
required_evidence: 全部原条件与全域一致收敛失效
critical_errors: 把逐点最终阈值统一到全域

stages.title: 全有界子集
required_evidence: 有限网论证或紧闭包证明
critical_errors: 把紧性证明的某个使用误作必要条件

turns.changed_assumptions: 紧完整域上处处观测改为任意域稠密点上的 Cauchy 数据并到实际完备化
turns.tempting_invalid_transfer: 继续假定原域完整或紧，或任意滤子可枚举
turns.correct_boundary: 统一 Lipschitz 界允许在完成域逐点恢复，紧集/移动输入须分别证明
turns.target_claim: 原共同 Lipschitz 界、稠密观测及真滤子 Cauchy 条件足以完成实际完备化上的全部恢复、紧集一致及同步移动输入目标。

turns.changed_assumptions: 从各紧集一致改问整个完成域一致
turns.tempting_invalid_transfer: 把每点/每紧集滤子事件交换成全域事件
turns.correct_boundary: 非紧域可有向无穷移动的尖峰
turns.target_claim: S4 的恢复结论总能加强为整个完成域上的一致收敛。

turns.changed_assumptions: 紧子集改为可能不闭的全有界子集
turns.tempting_invalid_transfer: 去掉闭性就否定一致收敛
turns.correct_boundary: 有限网已足够，或使用完成域内紧闭包
turns.target_claim: S4 的收敛在完成域的每个全有界子集上都一致，不要求该子集闭。

scoring.group_pass: Every stage completed correctly with assumption fidelity; diagnostic points never compensate for a failed mandatory stage.

alternative_proofs: Accept any valid complete short proof, equivalent classification or legal counterexample; no mandated proof route.

provenance.new_material: AI-authored original proofs, constructions and condition changes around the supplied public parent problem; no inherited model score, human approval or Lean coverage.
